verdict.rationale: The architecture docs state 'VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM', which is a documented hard boundary at the VM level. The overview reinforces this, saying each sandbox runs in an isolated container with 'strong security boundaries' and that untrusted code runs securely in isolated environments. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the VM/hypervisor technology and threat model, clarity on the mixed container-vs-VM wording, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.
